facts.business: Shree Krishna Infrastructure Limited is an Indian listed company engaged in infrastructure activities.

auditor.name: NKSC & Co., Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Due to change in management (shareholders) of the Company during the current financial year, the current management was not able to provide sufficient and appropriate financial/ accounting records to verify the transactions entered in the books of accounts of the Company such as bank statements, loan agreements, trade receivables and trade payables confirmations and invoices and supporting vouchers for sales and other expenses during the year. Further, we are unable to confirm or verify by alternative means the state of affairs of the Company for the year ended 31 March 2026 its profit and its cash flows for the year ended on that date.

key_risks: Change in management leading to inability to provide sufficient financial/accounting records
Inability to verify transactions, bank statements, loan agreements, trade receivables, trade payables, invoices and supporting vouchers
Going concern uncertainty due to lack of audit evidence
